title: Salvage work begins on tanker leaking oil off Oman, risk firm says
english: A salvage operation has started to stabilize an oil tanker that has been leaking crude off the coast of Oman since June. The ship, suspected of being part of Russia’s shadow fleet, has caused a massive oil spill that is now polluting local beaches and threatening the environment. Despite difficult monsoon weather, international experts are working with Omani authorities to secure the vessel and contain the damage.

title: Water supply for three US states drips down, Lake Mead at record low
english: Lake Mead, the largest reservoir in the United States, has reached an unprecedented low water level. Located between Nevada and Arizona, its decline by two-thirds threatens the water and electricity supply for millions of people. This crisis highlights the severe impact on resources across the western part of the country.

title: Brazil begins exploring retaliatory options to new US tariffs
english: The Brazilian government has begun formal consultations to consider retaliatory measures against the United States in response to new 25 percent tariffs imposed on various Brazilian exports. While no final decision has been reached, Brazil is exploring options such as taxing American imports or suspending certain patents to protect its economy. This move follows the US government's claims of unfair trade practices, which Brazil maintains are unjustified and arbitrary.

title: Mali says 82 soldiers captured by armed groups have been freed
english: The Malian military recently announced that 82 of its soldiers, who had been held captive by armed rebel groups in the northern part of the country, have been released. These troops were freed following mediation efforts by Algeria for humanitarian reasons, though there are conflicting reports regarding how long the individuals were held. While these soldiers are now safe under government care, rebel organizations claim that many others still remain in captivity.

title: Turkey's foreign minister accuses Israel of expelling Palestinians from Gaza
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has accused Israel of planning to forcibly remove all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip. During a meeting in Egypt, Fidan criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies as inhumane and called for urgent international pressure to stop the ongoing conflict. He also claimed that Turkey and Egypt have collaborated to mitigate the violence, even as Israeli military operations in the region continue.

title: Kushner expected to travel to Israel for Gaza talks next week: Report
english: Jared Kushner, serving as a Middle East envoy for President Trump, is planning a trip to Israel next week. The primary goal of his visit is to hold talks regarding the long-term future of Gaza. He intends to discuss strategies to further the progress of the administration's peace initiative for the region.

title: Vance says US will end up 'in a stronger position' than Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that the administration is utilizing a strategic mix of military, economic, and diplomatic tools to exert pressure on Iran. He criticized the Iranian government for failing to uphold its previous agreements and expressed confidence that current US actions will ultimately ensure Iran does not acquire nuclear weapons. Furthermore, he emphasized that these measures are intended to restore open access to the Strait of Hormuz and secure a dominant position for the United States.

oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, mootummaan isaanii dhiibbaa Iran irratti geessisuuf mala waraanaa, dinagdee fi dippilomaasii walitti makuun itti fayyadamaa akka jiru ibsan. Mootummaan Iran kakuu kanaan dura gale hin kabajne jedhanii, tarkaanfiin yeroo ammaa fudhatamaa jiru kun Iran meeshaa niwuukilaraa akka hin arganneef akka gargaaru dubbatan. title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
english: The White House has released a report claiming that over 40 countries, including Canada and India, have helped China bypass US tariffs by rerouting its goods through their borders. This practice, known as transshipping, allegedly costs the US billions in revenue and threatens American jobs by masking the true origin of Chinese products. In response, China has criticized these trade restrictions and emphasized that such unilateral actions harm global trade interests.

oromo: Mana Maree Adii (White House) gabaasa baaseen, biyyoonni 40 ol ta’an kanneen akka Kaanaadaa fi Indiyaa, Chaayinaan gibira Ameerikaa irraa fagaachuuf akka gargaaran ibseera. title: Why Osun’s election matters for Nigeria’s 2027 vote
english: The upcoming gubernatorial election in Osun State is viewed as a critical test of voter sentiment and political influence ahead of Nigeria’s 2027 presidential race. While the vote focuses on local leadership, it serves as an indicator of whether President Bola Tinubu’s party can maintain its stronghold in the southwest region. The outcome will demonstrate if the ruling party’s strategy of gaining support through political defections truly resonates with voters at the polls.
amharic: በኦሱን ግዛት ሊካሄድ የታቀደው የገዢነት ምርጫ የናይጄሪያን የ2027 የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ መንፈስ እና የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ለመለካት እንደ ወሳኝ ፈተና ይታያል። ምርጫው በክልል ደረጃ አመራርን የመምረጥ ዓላማ ቢኖረውም፣ የፕሬዝዳንት ቦላ ቲኑቡ ፓርቲ በደቡብ ምዕራብ ክልል ያለውን ተቀባይነት ለመገምገም እንደ መለኪያ ያገለግላል። የውጤቱ መፈታት ገዢው ፓርቲ በፖለቲካዊ ሽግግሮች የሚያገኘው ድጋፍ ከሕዝቡ በእርግጥ ድምጽ ሊያስገኝለት እንደሚችል ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoon bulchaa naannoo Osun godhamuuf jiru, filannoo prezidaantummaa Naayijeeriyaa kan bara 2027 dura fedhii fi humna siyaasaa uummataa madaaluuf akka qormaata guddaatti ilaalama. Filannichi ofiin isaatii kan naannoo ta'us, gareen Prezidaant Bola Tinuubuu naannoo kibba-dhihaa keessatti humni isaa ammas cimaa ta'uu isaa beekuuf gargaara. Bu'aan filannoo kanaa gareen bulchaa jiru kun jijjiirraa siyaasaan argatu kun dhugumatti deggeraalee uummataa irraa deggersa akka argatu kan mirkaneessu ta'a.

title: UN, Palestinian ministry condemn Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes
english: The United Nations and the Palestinian Foreign Ministry have strongly condemned an ongoing siege by Israeli settlers against three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra. For several days, these families have been trapped in their homes without access to water or electricity, amid accusations that the settlers are trying to force them off their land. International officials and Palestinian authorities have labeled these actions as criminal and terroristic, warning that the goal is the illegal displacement of the residents.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና የፍልስጤም የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር በሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ላይ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች እየተደረገ ያለውን ከበባ አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች ለቀናት ያህል ውኃ እና ኤሌክትሪክ ሳይኖራቸው በቤታቸው ታግደው የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ሰፋሪዎቹ ከምድራቸው ለማፈናቀል እየሞከሩ ነው የሚል ክስ ቀርቧል። ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት እና የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት ወንጀለኛ እና ሽብርተኝነት መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የነዋሪዎቹን በግዳጅ የማፈናቀል አላማ እንዳለው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Philaasxiim, gandoota Qusraa kan Lixaa Baankii (West Bank) keessatti gandoonni Israa'el maatiiwwan Philaasxiim sadan irratti marsaa gaggeessaa jiran jabeessee balaaleffateera. Maatiiwwan kunneen guyyoota muraasaaf bishaanii fi ibsaa malee mana isaanii keessatti hidhamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, qe'ee isaanii irraa isaan buqqisuuf yaalii godhamaa jiruun himatamu. Qaamoleen idil-addunyaa fi bulchiinsi Philaasxiim gochi kun yakka fi shororkeessummaa ta'uu ibsuun, kaayyoon isaa maatiiwwan kunneen dirqamaan buqqisuu akka ta'e akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Could Trump actually run for a third term as president?
english: Although Donald Trump has occasionally teased the possibility of serving more than two terms as U.S. president, he acknowledges that current laws prevent this. The U.S. Constitution strictly limits presidents to two terms in office. Despite his rhetoric, there is no legal pathway for him to seek a third term.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ከሁለት ጊዜ በላይ ማገልገል እንደሚችሉ አልፎ አልፎ ፍንጭ ቢሰጡም፣ አሁን ያለው ህግ ይህን እንደማይፈቅድ ይገነዘባሉ። የአሜሪካ ህገ መንግስት ፕሬዝዳንቶች ሁለት ጊዜ ብቻ እንዲያገለግሉ ይገድባል። በትራምፕ በኩል የሚነገሩ ወሬዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ሶስተኛ ጊዜ ለመወዳደር የሚያስችል ምንም አይነት ህጋዊ መንገድ የለም።
oromo: Donald Trump yeroo tokko tokko yeroo lamatti booda pirezidaantummaa Ameerikaa itti fufuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaa himus, seera amma jiruun kun akka hin danda'amne beeka. Heera mootummaa Ameerikaatiin pirezidaantonni yeroo lama qofa tajaajiluuf mirga qabu. Haasaa isaa keessatti yoo kaase illee, yeroo sadaffaaf akka filatamuuf gadi ba'uuf seeraan karaa baname hin jiru.

title: Bodycam captures lightning striking metres from US police officers
english: A bodycam video recorded the startling moment lightning struck extremely close to South Dakota state troopers. The officers were chasing a suspect on foot when the incident occurred. Fortunately, none of the police personnel were harmed by the lightning strike.
amharic: በደቡብ ዳኮታ የሀይዌይ ፓትሮል መኮንኖች አንድን ተጠርጣሪ በእግር ሲያሳድዱ የነበረበት የሰውነት ካሜራ በአቅራቢያቸው የተከሰተውን የመብረቅ አደጋ ቀርጿል። መብረቁ የተከሰተው መኮንኖቹ ካሉበት ጥቂት ሜትሮች ርቀት ላይ ቢሆንም፣ በደረሰው አደጋ ማንም የፖሊስ አባል ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Viidiyoon kaameeraa qaamaa irratti hidhattee jirtu, poolisoonni South Dakota bakka tokkotti namoota shakku tokko hordofaa utuu jiranii qaqqaawwee xiyyeeffannoo uummataa hawwate agarsiiseetti. Qaqqaawween kun poolisoota kanneen irraa meetira muraasa qofa fagaatee kan bu'e yoo ta'u, gama isaaniitiin miidhaan qaamaa tokkollee irra hin geenye.

title: Talks between government and opposition mark a new chapter for Venezuela
english: The Venezuelan government and opposition parties recently concluded a historic round of talks aimed at addressing the nation's severe economic and political crises. The two sides reached a preliminary agreement to recover frozen international assets to fund earthquake relief and to significantly overhaul the country's judiciary system. While citizens like teachers and pensioners are cautiously optimistic about these reforms, many remain vigilant, calling for continued pressure to ensure genuine change.
amharic: የቬንዙዌላ መንግስት እና የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች ሀገሪቱን እያመሰ ያለውን ኢኮኖሚያዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ችግሮች ለመፍታት ታሪካዊ ውይይት አድርገዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በውጭ ሀገራት የታገዱ ንብረቶችን ለተፈጥሮ አደጋ መከላከል ለማዋል እና የፍትህ ስርዓቱን በስፋት ለማሻሻል ተስማምተዋል። በሀገሪቱ ያሉ ሰራተኞች እና ጡረተኞች ለውጡን በጉጉት ቢጠባበቁም፣ እውነተኛ መሻሻል ለማምጣት ተከታታይ ክትትል እንደሚያስፈልግ በመግለጽ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan Venzuweelaa fi gareen mormituu biyyattii rakkoo diinagdee fi siyaasaa biyyattii mudate furuuf marii seena qabeessa ta'e tokko xumuraniiru. Gareen kunneen qabeenya alatti qabame deebifachuun gargaarsa hatattamaaf oolchuu fi sirna haqaa biyyattii jijjiiruuf waliigalteerra gahuu danda'aniiru. Hawaasni fi hojjettoonni biyyattii jijjiirama kanaaf abdii kan qaban ta'us, jijjiiramni dhugaan akka dhufuuf hordoffii cimaa gochuun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli army fired at civilians in Syria's Daraa province
english: Syrian state media reported that Israeli military forces shot at civilians in the Daraa province. The attack caused residents in the village of Maariya to flee their homes for safety. Fortunately, there have been no confirmed reports of casualties following this incident.
amharic: የሶሪያ የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሶሪያ ዳራ ግዛት በሚኖሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ተኩስ መክፈታቸውን ዘግበዋል። በዚህ ጥቃት ምክንያት የማሪያ መንደር ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲሰደዱ ተገደዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ በደረሰው ጉዳት የሟቾች ወይም የቆሰሉ ሰዎች መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Suuriyaa akka gabaasanitti, loltoonni Israa'eel naannoo Daaraa keessatti namoota nagaa irratti dhukaasa bananii jiru. Dhukaasa kanaan kan ka'e, jiraattoonni baadiyaa Maariyaa jedhamu irraa buqqa'uun dirqamanii jiru. Gabaasni lubbuun darbe ykn miidhaan qaamaa ga'e hanga ammaatti hin jiru.

title: Report: Iraqi air defences intercept drones over Erbil
english: Iraqi defense systems successfully shot down multiple drones near the airport in Erbil early Thursday morning. Parts of the destroyed drones landed in a nearby neighborhood, but fortunately, no one was harmed during the incident. Authorities have confirmed that there are no reported injuries or fatalities resulting from the attempt.
amharic: የኢራቅ የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት እሮብ እለት ማለዳ ላይ በአርቢል አየር ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ የሚበሩ ድሮኖችን መትቶ ጥሏል። የተደመሰሱት ድሮኖች ስብርባሪዎች በመኖሪያ አካባቢ ላይ ቢወድቁም፣ በሰዎች ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በክስተቱ ምክንያት የተጎዳ ሰው የለም።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa qilleensaa Iraaq guyyaa Kamisaa ganama naannoo buufata xiyyaaraa Erbilitti xiyyaara malee feettuu (drones) tokko tokko rukutee kuseera. Xiyyaara kanneen irraa kan hafe bakka namoonni jiraatanitti kan kufe ta'us, namni miidhame hin jiru. Aangeyyoonni akka ibsanitti, haala kanaan miidhaan lubbuus ta'e qaamaa namoota irra hin ga'e.

title: Israeli forces will not withdraw from south Lebanon or Gaza, Katz says
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has declared that the country's military will maintain its presence in designated security zones within southern Lebanon and Gaza. This statement contradicts a recent agreement that conditioned an Israeli withdrawal on the disarmament of Hezbollah. The United States has criticized the minister's position, noting that it conflicts with Israel's prior commitments.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ የእስራኤል ጦር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ በሚገኙ የደህንነት ቀጠናዎች ውስጥ መቆየቱን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ እስራኤል ከሊባኖስ የምትወጣው ሂዝቦላህ ትጥቅ ሲፈታ ነው በሚለው የቅርብ ጊዜ ስምምነት ላይ ጥላ አጥልቷል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት ይህ የካቲዝ አቋም እስራኤል ቀደም ብላ የገባችውን ቃል የሚቃረን ነው በማለት ተችቶታል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, waraanni isaanii naannolee nageenyaa jedhamanii moggaafaman kan kibba Libaanoosii fi Gaazaatii akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun walii galtee kanaan dura Israa'el harka fuudhiinsa hidhannoo Hizbullaatiin walqabatee Libaanoosii ba'uuf galame faallaa kan dhaabbatuudha. Mootummaan Ameerikaa, yaada ministirichaa kana ibsi Israa'el kanaan dura galtee turte kan faallessuudha jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Bessent says US set to apply measures never seen on Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States is preparing to implement unprecedented economic sanctions against Iran. These measures, expected to be revealed next week, aim to achieve total economic isolation. The plan also includes a strict blockade of the Strait of Hormuz to stop all maritime trade involving Iranian ports.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ማቀዷን አስታውቀዋል። በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት ይፋ እንደሚደረጉ የሚጠበቁት እነዚህ እርምጃዎች፣ ኢራንን ሙሉ ለሙሉ ከዓለም ኢኮኖሚ ለመነጠል ያለሙ ናቸው። በተጨማሪም በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር በማድረግ ወደ ኢራን ወደቦች የሚደረግ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን ለማቆም አቅደዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqaa Amerikaa Iskooti Beseent akka jedhanitti, Amerikaan Iran irratti tarkaanfii dinagdee kanaan dura hin mul'anne fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jirti. Tarkaanfiiwwan torban dhufu ifoomuuf jiran kun, Iran addunyaa irraa guutummaatti addaan baasuuf kan kaayyeffatan dha. Karoorri kun daldalli bakkeewwan Iran keessa akka hin darbineef galaana Hormuz irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu kan of keessatti qabatu dha.

title: Israeli defence minister inaugurates new illegal settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz recently opened a new settlement in the Jenin region of the occupied West Bank. This move occurred on the same day that Israeli forces destroyed various Palestinian-owned shops and properties. Although Katz acknowledged that settler violence negatively impacts Israel's international reputation, the government continues to expand illegal settlements across Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ጀኒን አካባቢ አዲስ ሰፈራ መመስረታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የፍልስጤም ባለቤትነት ያላቸውን ሱቆች እና ንብረቶች ካወደሙበት ዕለት ጋር ነው። ካትዝ በአዲሱ ሰፈራ ምክንያት የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት በእስራኤል ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ እስራኤል በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች ውስጥ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎችን ማስፋፋቷን ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz naannoo Jenin kan bakka qabamee jiru West Bank keessatti qubannaa haaraa bananiiru. Tarkaanfin kun guyyaa waraanni Israa'el qabeenyaa fi suuqiiwwan warra Filisxeemii mancaasanii dha. Ministirichi miidhaan qubattootaan gahu sun biyya Israa'el irratti dhiibbaa hamaa akka qabu hubachiisanis, mootummaan Israa'el lafa Filisxeemii keessatti qubannaa seeraan alaa babal'isuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: UAE accuses Iran of attacks on two ADNOC vessels in Strait of Hormuz
english: The United Arab Emirates has accused Iran of attacking two oil tankers belonging to its national company while they were passing through the Strait of Hormuz. Although no injuries were reported, the UAE condemned these hostile acts as piracy and a significant threat to global energy stability. This incident follows a series of similar attacks on vessels in the region amid ongoing tensions and blockades between Iran and the United States.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ሲያልፉ የነበሩ ሁለት የነዳጅ መርከቦቿ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን ከሰሰች። ምንም እንኳን በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት ባይኖርም፣ ኤሚሬቶች ድርጊቱን የባህር ላይ ወንበዴነት እና ለአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ደህንነት ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጻለች። ይህ ጥቃት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ባለው ውጥረት እና በተፈጠረው የባህር መተላለፊያ እገዳ ምክንያት የተፈጠሩ ተከታታይ ግጭቶች አካል ነው።
oromo: Emirates Arabaa Gamtoomte, dooniiwwan boba'aa kan kambanii biyyattii lama ta'an gara hargantoo Hormuz darbuu isaanii irratti Iran haleellaa raawwatte jechuun himatteetti. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuu kan hin qaqqabne ta'us, biyyattiin gocha kana saaminsa galaana fi xalayaa nageenya anniisaa addunyaa irra jiru irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabuun balaaleffatteetti. Haleellaan kun dhiibbaa fi duula galaana irratti Itoophiyaa fi Ameerikaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan uumame yoo ta'u, miidhaan gosa kanaa yeroo dhihoo as deddeebi'ee kan mudatuu dha.

title: Yemen faces highest risk of returning to war since 2022 truce, UN warns
english: The United Nations has warned that Yemen is facing its greatest risk of returning to full-scale war since the 2022 truce began. Fighting between Houthi rebels and government forces has intensified recently, resulting in both military and civilian casualties across several regions. The UN envoy is urging all sides to de-escalate, prioritize economic stability, and return to peace negotiations to prevent the crisis from deepening.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በየመን ከ2022 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በኋላ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የመቀስቀስ አደጋ እንደተጋረጠ አስጠንቅቋል። በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች እና በመንግስት ሃይሎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት በበርካታ አካባቢዎች የሲቪል እና የወታደር ሞት እያስከተለ ይገኛል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት መልዕክተኛ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ግጭቱን እንዲቀንሱ፣ ለኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ እና የሰላም ንግግሮችን እንዲጀምሩ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa akka ibsetti, Yaman waraana waggaa 2022 taasifame booda hanga ammaatti waraana guddaa irra deebi'ee jalqabamuuf balaa guddaa keessa jirti. Gidduu kana haleellaa fi walitti bu'iinsa garee Huutii fi waraana mootummaa gidduutti taasifameen lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbee jira. Ergamaan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa gamachuun walitti bu'iinsa dhaabuuf, nageenya biyyattii fi guddina dinagdee akka durfanii hojjetan hunda isaaniiyyuu gaafateera.

title: Iran war live: US eyes indefinite Iran naval blockade
english: The United States is considering a long-term naval blockade of Iran as part of its strategy to influence the regional conflict. Vice President JD Vance explained that these actions aim to keep energy prices stable and stop Iran from developing nuclear weapons. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth added that the American military is prepared to maintain this blockade indefinitely to ensure a stronger geopolitical position.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የባህር ላይ እገዳን ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ለመጣል እያሰበች ነው። ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ እንደገለፁት፣ ይህ እርምጃ የኢነርጂ ዋጋን ለማረጋጋት እና ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ በበኩላቸው፣ አሜሪካ ጠንካራ አቋም ለመያዝ ይህንን እገዳ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ለመቀጠል ዝግጁ መሆኗን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa garee waraana Iran irratti uggura markaboota yeroo dheeraaf turuu danda'u tokko kaa'uuf karoorfatteetti. Itti-aanaan Preezdaantii JD Vance akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun gatii anniisaa tasgabbeessuu fi Iran meeshaa niwukileraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha. Ministirri Ittisaa Pete Hegseth gamasaaniin, Amerikaan iddoo cimaa keessa jiraachuuf uggura kana yeroo barbaadame hunda itti fufsiisuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru.

title: Gaza City police chief killed as Israel pushes on with deadly strikes
english: The head of Gaza City's police force, Colonel Jamal Abu Kamil, was killed in an Israeli drone strike as air raids resumed following a brief pause. Israeli forces claimed the official was a Hamas commander, though this was denied by Gaza police authorities. Additional strikes in Khan Younis and Beit Lahiya have also resulted in further fatalities, marking an escalation despite recent international efforts to maintain a ceasefire.
amharic: የጋዛ ከተማ የፖሊስ ዋና አዛዥ ኮሎኔል ጀማል አቡ ካሚል በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ተገደሉ። እስራኤል ግለሰቡን የሀማስ አዛዥ ነው በማለት የገደለችው ቢሆንም፣ የጋዛ ፖሊስ ይህንን ክስ አስተባብለዋል። በካን ዩኒስ እና በቤት ላሂያ በተፈጸሙ ሌሎች ጥቃቶች ተጨማሪ ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ቀደም ሲል የተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል።
oromo: Ajajaan poolisii magaalaa Gaaza Kolonel Jamaal Abuu Kaamil xiyyaara nama hin qabneen rukutamee ajjeefameera. Israa'el namni kun hogganaa haamaas ta'uu isaa ibsitee kan ajjeefte ta'us, poolisiin Gaaza himannaa kana haaleera. Godina Kaani Yuunis fi Beet Laahiyaatti weerarawwan biroo gaggeeffamaniin lubbuun namoota kanneen biroo darbuun, carraaqqii tasgabbii fi nagaa fiduuf taasifamaa ture miidheera.

title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
english: A Ryanair flight from Greece to Germany was forced to return to the airport after an engine fan blade broke, sending debris into the cabin window. The impact shattered the glass, partially pulling a passenger through the opening before others helped hold him inside. Investigators are currently reviewing the incident, which occurred despite the engine passing a maintenance inspection only two months earlier.
amharic: ከግሪክ ወደ ጀርመን ይበር የነበረው የራያን ኤር አውሮፕላን የሞተር ክፍል በመሰበሩ ምክንያት ወደ መነሻው እንዲመለስ ተገዷል። የተሰበረው የሞተር አካል በመስኮቱ ላይ በመምታቱ አንድ ተሳፋሪ ወደ ውጭ ሊወጣ ተቃርቦ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በሌሎች ተሳፋሪዎች እርዳታ ሊድን ችሏል። የትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ባለስልጣናት፣ አውሮፕላኑ ከሁለት ወራት በፊት ምርመራ ተደርጎለት የነበረ ቢሆንም ለዚህ አደጋ መፈጠር ምክንያት የሆነውን ጉዳይ እየመረመሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Raayaan Eer (Ryanair) kan Giriikii gara Jarmanii imalaa ture, kutaaleen injinii isaa cabanii foddaa irratti erga rukutanii booda gara buufata xiyyaaraatti deebi'uuf dirqameera. Cabni injinii sun foddaa cabsee tures, abbaa warraa tokko gara alaatti harkisuu jalqabe; namoonni biroos isa qabuun lubbuun isaa akka hin darbe gargaaraniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa qorannoo godhan, injiniin xiyyaarichaa ji'a lama dura qoratamee kan ture ta'us, sababa rakkoo kanaa adda baasuuf qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Tate supporters rally for brothers ahead of bail hearing in Miami
english: Supporters of Andrew and Tristan Tate held a demonstration outside a Miami detention center to demand their release before a bail hearing. The brothers are currently facing potential extradition to the United Kingdom to answer for serious criminal allegations, including sexual assault and human trafficking. Participants at the rally showed their backing for the siblings through chants and physical exercises near the facility.
amharic: የአንድሪው እና ትሪስታን ቴይት ደጋፊዎች የዋስትና ችሎታቸውን አስመልክቶ በማያሚ በሚገኝ ማቆያ ጣቢያ ውጭ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ወንድማማቾቹ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በድብደባ፣ በጾታዊ ንግድ እና በግፍ ወንጀሎች የተከሰሱ ሲሆን ወደዚያ እንዲላኩ እየተጠባበቁ ነው። የተሰበሰቡት ደጋፊዎች ወንድማማቾቹ እንዲፈቱ በመጠየቅ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Deggertoonni Andrew fi Tristan Tate mana hidhaa Maayamiitti argamuun gadihiinsaa isaanii gaafachuu fi dhaddacha wabii isaanii dura hiriira ba'an. Obboloonni kun UK keessatti himannaa gudeeddii, daldala qaamaa fi miidhaa qaamaa irratti dhihaateen wal qabatee gara achitti ergamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Hiriirtotni kunneen sagalee dhageessisuu fi qaama isaanii sochii gochuun obboloota kanaaf deggersa qaban agarsiisaniiru.

title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, including police chief
english: Israeli drone strikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of two individuals, one of whom was a local police chief. The attack also left several other people injured during the incident on Thursday. This military action follows Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's recent refusal to accept a new peace proposal suggested by US President Donald Trump.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት የፖሊስ አዛዥን ጨምሮ ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። በዚሁ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ያቀረቡትን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ ቀናት በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gaaza keessatti xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeesseen ajajaan poolisii tokkoo fi namni biraan tokko du'aniiru. Haleellaa Roobii guyyaa keessa mudate kanaan namoonni biroo hedduunis miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan mudate erga muummichi ministeeraa Beenjaamiin Neetanyaahuu qajeelfama nagaa pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp dhiyeessan fudhachuu didanii guyyoota muraasa boodadha.

title: Mexico says Colombia rejected its earthquake rescue team
english: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum claims that Colombia blocked a Mexican military rescue team from assisting with earthquake relief efforts despite their international certification. Colombia denies any political motivation for this decision, stating that they are simply requiring all incoming rescue groups to meet specific UN-backed standards. While the rescue team remains grounded, Colombia confirmed it is still accepting other forms of humanitarian aid, such as food and medical supplies, from Mexico.
amharic: የሜክሲኮ ፕሬዝዳንት ክላውዲያ ሼይንባም ኮሎምቢያ ዓለም አቀፍ እውቅና ያላቸውን የሜክሲኮ የነፍስ አድን ቡድን በምድር ነውጥ አደጋ ወቅት እንዳይረዱ መከልከሏን ተናግረዋል። የኮሎምቢያ መንግስት ይህ ውሳኔ ከፖለቲካ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው እና የውጭ አገር የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ያወጣውን መስፈርት ማሟላት እንዳለባቸው አስታውቋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኑ ጉዞ ቢሰረዝም፣ ኮሎምቢያ ከሜክሲኮ የሚመጡ የምግብ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁሶችን እርዳታ መቀበሏን ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Meksikoo Klaawudiyaa Sheeyinbaam akka jedhanitti, Kolombiyaan gareen ogeeyyii fayyisuu biyyattii sochii gargaarsa kirkira lafaa irratti akka hirmaatan hin hayyamne. Kolombiyaan murtoon kun siyaasaan kan wal qabate miti jettee, gareen gargaarsa biyya alaa kamiyyuu sadarkaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin kaa'ame guutuu akka qaban ibsiteetti. Gareen fayyisuu kun gara biyyatti akka hin deemne kan dhorkame ta'us, Kolombiyaan gargaarsa nyaataa fi qorichaa biyya Meksikoo irraa dhufe fudhachuu ishee itti fufteetti.

title: Multiple houses ablaze as wildfire sweeps into UK town
english: A large wildfire reached the outskirts of Stourbridge, UK, causing significant damage to at least six residential properties. Emergency responders worked to control the fire and thick smoke, which resulted in two people suffering from smoke inhalation and heat exposure. As a safety precaution, local train services were temporarily halted while crews managed the situation.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ስቶርብሪጅ ከተማ ዳርቻ በተነሳ ከፍተኛ የዱር እሳት ቢያንስ ስድስት የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ተቃጥለዋል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ቡድኖች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ሲሰሩ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ሁለት ሰዎች በጭስ እና በሙቀት ምክንያት ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በስፍራው የነበረውን አደጋ ተከትሎ የአካባቢው የባቡር አገልግሎት ለጊዜው ተቋርጦ ነበር።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa guddaa magaalaa Stourbridge kan UK qarqaraatti ka’een, manneen jireenyaa yoo xiqqaate ja’a ta’an barbadaa’aniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa ibiddaafi aara hammaataa to’achuuf yeroo hojjechaa turanitti, namoonni lama aaraafi hoo’a irraa miidhamaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, rakkoo nageenyaa ittisuuf tajaajilli baaburaa naannichaa yeroof dhaabatee ture.

title: Are We in the Singularity?
english: Recent claims from figures like Sam Altman suggest we may have reached the technological singularity, a point where artificial intelligence surpasses human capabilities. This discussion was sparked after AI successfully solved a long-standing mathematical challenge in a single attempt. Experts are now debating whether these advancements represent a genuine turning point in human history or if they are simply a form of corporate promotion.
amharic: እንደ ሳም አልትማን ያሉ ግለሰቦች አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ የሰውን ችሎታ የሚበልጥበት የቴክኖሎጂ አብዮት ወይም 'ሲንጉላሪቲ' ደረጃ ላይ ደርሰን ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ውይይት የተነሳው አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ለሃያ ዓመታት መፍትሄ ሳይገኝለት የቆየ የሂሳብ ችግርን በአንዴ መፍታት በመቻሉ ነው። አሁን ባለሙያዎች እነዚህ ለውጦች በእርግጥ ታሪካዊ ምዕራፍ መሆናቸውን ወይም የንግድ ማስታወቂያ ብቻ መሆናቸውን በመከራከር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoonni akka Sam Altman jiran, tarkaanfiin teeknoolojii gara sadarkaa 'singularity' jedhamutti ce'uusaa himaa jiru; kunis dandeettiin aritifishal intelejensi (AI) kan namaa caaluudha. Yaadni kun kan ka'e, AI rakkoo herregaa waggaa digdamii turtee furamuu hin dandeenye tokko yeroo tokkotti furuu danda'uusatiin wal qabatee dha. Hayyoonni ammaa inni kun jijjiirama dhugaa kan seenaa moo gurgurtaa meeshaalee guddifachuuf kan godhamuudha jechuun falmaa jiru.

title: Sudan army says RSF advance on key town bordering Ethiopia
english: The Sudanese paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and their allies have advanced into the strategically significant border town of Kurmuk, causing the national army to withdraw. The town serves as a vital transit point between Sudan and Ethiopia, making control of the area highly contested. Meanwhile, in North Kordofan, the Sudanese army reported successfully repelling a large-scale RSF assault on the transport hub of Jabra al-Sheikh.
amharic: የሱዳን نیم-ወታደራዊ ቡድን የሆኑት ፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) እና አጋሮቻቸው ከኢትዮጵያ ጋር በሚዋሰነው ስልታዊ በሆነው የኩርሙክ ከተማ መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ የሱዳን ጦር አካባቢውን ለቆ መውጣቱ ተሰምቷል። ከተማዋ በሱዳን እና በኢትዮጵያ መካከል አስፈላጊ የመተላለፊያ መስመር በመሆኗ ለቁጥጥሯ ከፍተኛ ፍጥጫ እየተካሄደባት ይገኛል። በሌላ በኩል በሰሜን ኮርዶፋን ግዛት የሱዳን ጦር በጃብራ አል-ሼክ ከተማ ላይ የተከፈተን መጠነ ሰፊ የRSF ጥቃት ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni deeggarsa ariifachiisaa (RSF) fi gareewwan isaanii magaalaa Kurmuk ishee daangaa Itiyoophiyaa irra jirtu qabatanii jiru, kunis waraana biyyoolessaa naannichaa gadi dhiisee akka ba'u dirqisiiseera. Magaalaan kun sarmaddoo daandii biyyoota lamaan gidduu jirtu waan taateef, to'annoo ishee irratti wal dhabdee cimaatu jira. Gama biraatiin, naannoo Kordofaan Kaabaatti, waraanni Sudaan haleellaa gareen RSF magaalaa Jabra al-Sheikh irratti banan milkaa'inaan of irraa ittisuu isaa ibseera.

title: Passenger train derails, injuring several in southern England
english: A passenger train went off the tracks near Lewes in East Sussex, England, causing at least one carriage to overturn. The accident left at least 11 people injured, with two victims reported to be in serious condition. Rescue teams were dispatched to help those trapped, and officials have launched an investigation to determine what caused the derailment.
amharic: በደቡባዊ እንግሊዝ፣ ኢስት ሰሴክስ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ የባቡር ሀዲድ ላይ የደረሰ የባቡር አደጋ ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎችን አቁስሏል። ከአደጋው ጋር ተያይዞ ቢያንስ አንድ የባቡር ክፍል በመገልበጡ በርካታ መንገደኞች ታግተው ነበር፣ ከእነዚህም መካከል ሁለቱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ingiliz kibbaatti naannoo Luwesitti baaburri imaltootaa karaa irraa waan baheef namoota 11 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Balaa kanaan kutaawwan baaburichaa keessaa tokko kan garagalche yoo ta'u, namoota hedduus daandii irratti akka hafan godheera; isaan keessaa lamaan isaanii miidhaa cimaatu irra gahe. Qaamoleen nageenyaa haala balaa kanaa irratti qorannoo eegalaniiru.

title: Israeli forces order families to evacuate homes in Qusra
english: Israeli military forces have commanded Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra to leave their residences. Following a period of aggressive actions by settlers, soldiers have occupied these homes and placed strict limitations on the movement of the local residents. The situation remains tense as the military continues to control these properties.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አዘዋል። በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ሰፋሪዎች ከደረሰ ጥቃት በኋላ ወታደሮቹ ቤቶቹን ተቆጣጥረው የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ከፍተኛ ገደብ ጥለዋል። ወታደሮቹ በቤቶቹ ውስጥ በመስፈራቸው ምክንያት በስፍራው ያለው ውጥረት ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humnootiin waraana Israa'el maatiiwwan Falasxiin ganda Qusraa kan Lixaa Baankii keessa jiraatan manasaanii gadi dhiisanii akka ba'an ajajaniiru. Erga weerara saafartootaan isaanirra ga'ee booda, waraanni manneen kana qabachuun sochiin jiraattotaa irratti daangaa cimaa kaa'aniiru. Waraanni manneen kana to'achuusaatiin walitti bu'iinsiifi sodaanni naannichaa itti fufee jira.

title: Colombia earthquake: Hospitals adapt to save lives amid widespread damage
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Colombia has caused significant destruction, resulting in over 270 deaths and thousands of injuries. Several hospitals in the city of Cali were severely damaged, forcing medical staff to focus exclusively on life-saving procedures for critical patients. Despite the strain on healthcare services, relief efforts and government support have helped stabilize the situation as rescue operations continue for those still missing.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተው የ7.4 መጠነ መለኪያ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያስከተለ ሲሆን ከ270 በላይ ሰዎች እንዲሞቱ እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ እንዲቆስሉ አድርጓል። በካሊ ከተማ የሚገኙ በርካታ ሆስፒታሎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ስለደረሰባቸው የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ለከባድ ታማሚዎች የህይወት አድን ስራ ላይ ብቻ እንዲያተኩሩ ተገደዋል። ምንም እንኳን የህክምና አገልግሎቱ ከፍተኛ ጫና ቢኖርበትም፣ በመንግስት ድጋፍ እና በበጎ ፈቃደኞች ጥረት የጤና ተቋማቱ ሁኔታ እየተረጋጋ እና የፍለጋ ስራዎችም ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Kolombiya keessatti sochiin lafaa hanga 7.4 ga'u mudate lubbuu namoota 270 ol galaafatee, namoota kumaatamaan lakka'amanis miidheera. Magaalaa Kaaliitti hospitaalonni hedduun waan caccabaniif, ogeeyyonni fayyaa kanneen lubbuun isaanii haala baay'ee hamaa keessa jiru qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuuf dirqamaniiru. Tajaajilli fayyaa dhiphina keessa yoo jiru illee, deggarsa mootummaa fi hirmaannaa namoota fedhiidhaan hojjetaniin haalli hospitaalotaa tasgabbaa'aa kan jiru yoo ta'u, hojiin barbaacha namoota badee jirus itti fufee jira.

title: Israeli army confirms killing Gaza’s police director
english: The Israeli military announced on Thursday that they killed Gaza's police chief, Jamal Abu Kamil. Officials stated that Abu Kamil was a Hamas leader who participated in the October 7 attacks against Israel. His death was confirmed as part of ongoing military operations in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል የጋዛ የፖሊስ አዛዥ የሆኑትን ጃማል አቡ ካሚልን መግደሉን ሐሙስ ዕለት አስታውቋል። እስራኤል እንደገለጸችው አቡ ካሚል በጥቅምት 7 በደረሰው ጥቃት ላይ የተሳተፈ የሃማስ አዛዥ ነበር። ግድያው የተፈጸመው በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ባለው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ማዕቀፍ ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa’el ajajaan poolisii Gaazaa Jamaal Abuu Kaamil ajjeeffachuu isaa guyyaa Kamisaa beeksiseera. Israa’el akka ibsitetti, Abuu Kaamil hogganaa dhaabbata Haamaas yoo ta’u, muddee 7 bara darbe haleellaa Israa’el irratti raawwatame keessatti hirmaachuu isaa himteetti. Ajjeechaan kun duula waraanaa naannichatti geggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan raawwatameedha.

title: Houthi missiles target Yemen’s Bab el-Mandeb Strait
english: The Houthi group in Yemen has launched two missiles toward the Bab el-Mandeb strait. This report was confirmed by a local source through the group's official media channel. The strait remains a critical maritime passage for global shipping.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በባቢ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ሁለት ሚሳኤሎችን ተኩሰዋል። ይህንን መረጃ የቡድኑ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ በአካባቢው ካለ ምንጭ በመጥቀስ ይፋ አድርጓል። ይህ የባህር መስመር ለዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦች ከፍተኛ ጠቀሜታ ያለው ቦታ ነው።

title: Saudi defence minister calls Iraq 'cherished neighbour' after strikes
english: Saudi Arabia’s defense minister met with a high-ranking Iraqi military official to discuss strengthening security ties and regional cooperation. This meeting signals a diplomatic attempt to improve relations following recent tensions caused by airstrikes targeting pro-Iran militia groups in Iraq. The minister reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's commitment to supporting Iraq’s stability, describing the country as a valued neighbor.

Mariin kun kan gaggeeffame, erga haleellaa qilleensa irraa gareewwan Iraaq keessa jiran irratti raawwatamee booda waldhabdee uumame hir’isuufi. title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
english: Romania has closed its only nuclear power plant because extreme heat has caused water levels in the Danube River to drop significantly. The facility, which provides one-fifth of the country's electricity, relies on the river for cooling and is expected to remain offline for at least ten days. This incident highlights the growing impact of climate change on European energy infrastructure as water supplies become increasingly scarce.

title: Carrick urges Manchester United to sign more transfers to boost title bid
english: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has called on the club to increase their transfer spending to remain competitive against rivals like Manchester City and Chelsea. Although the club has already signed new players, their total investment remains significantly lower than other top teams. Carrick emphasized the need for more depth and quality to secure a league title, especially with the new season approaching quickly.

title: Judge nixes Trump lawsuit alleging Harvard did not protect Jewish students
english: A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit filed by the Trump administration against Harvard University, which accused the school of failing to protect Jewish students from discrimination during pro-Palestinian protests. The judge ruled that the government failed to provide sufficient evidence of systemic civil rights violations, describing the reported incidents as too isolated to support the claims. This decision marks another legal setback for the administration, which has previously attempted to use federal funding as leverage to influence university responses to campus demonstrations.

Murtii kanaan bulchiinsi Trump yuuniversitiiwwan irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf yaaluun isaa isa lammataa seeraan dura dhaabbateera.

title: Poland arrests man who allegedly tried to kill Ukrainian American
english: Polish authorities have arrested a Russian citizen for allegedly planning the assassination of a Ukrainian-American in Warsaw. Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the plot as a dangerous escalation, noting it is the first time Russia has attempted to attack a U.S. citizen within a NATO nation. Security officials successfully intercepted the suspect before the attack could be carried out.

Humnoonni nageenyaa Pooland haleellaan kun osoo hin raawwatamin dura shakkamaa kana to'annaa jala oolchuu danda'aniiru.

title: Gaza mural for Burger King worker fired for shouting ‘Free Palestine’
english: Artists in Gaza have created a mural to show support for Arianna Hamilton, a former Burger King employee. Hamilton lost her job after expressing solidarity with Palestinians during a conversation with a customer at her workplace in Pennsylvania. The artwork serves as a public recognition of her actions.

oromo: Artistoonni Gaaza keessatti argaman, hojjettuu duraanii Burger King kan taate Arianna Hamilton deeggaruuf jechuudha miidhagsuu qodaa irratti suuraa ishee kaasan. Suuraan kun gocha isheen raawwatteef kabaja agarsiisuuf kan qophaaye dha.

title: Trump administration ‘gutted’ federal civil rights enforcement, HRW says
english: A report by Human Rights Watch claims that the Trump administration significantly weakened federal civil rights enforcement by reducing staff and changing policies. Key agencies, including the Department of Justice and the Department of Education, saw massive personnel cuts and stopped actively investigating discrimination cases. This shift has removed critical protections for minorities and vulnerable groups that were previously managed at the federal level.

title: Hamas denounces Israel's killing of top Gaza police official
english: Hamas has officially condemned Israel for the killing of Gaza’s police chief, Colonel Jamal Abu Kamil. The group described the attack as an intentional effort by Israeli forces to create disorder within the territory. Meanwhile, health officials in Gaza report that Israeli military strikes have resulted in over 1,250 Palestinian deaths since the ceasefire ended in October 2025.

title: Israel killed head of police force, Gaza’s ministry of interior says
english: Israeli drone strikes in Gaza have resulted in the death of Gaza City's police chief, Jamal Abu Kamil, and another individual. These attacks occurred despite an ongoing ceasefire agreement that was established in October 2025. Military operations have persisted across various parts of the territory, causing additional casualties and injuries among the local population.

Humni waraana Israa'el naannolee gara garaa keessatti haleellaa itti fufuun isaa lubbuu namaa fi miidhaan akka dabalu taasiseera.

title: Exclusive: UK Charity Commission criticises synagogue for hosting Great Israeli Real Estate Event
english: The UK Charity Commission has reprimanded the Edgware United Synagogue for holding an event that advertised properties located in illegal Israeli settlements. Because of this controversy, the regulator is now reopening its investigation into the synagogue's compliance. Officials have warned that they may take stricter regulatory actions if additional issues are discovered regarding the charity's conduct.

Kanaan walqabatee, qaamni to'annoo kun dhimma mana sagadaa kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa ture irra deebi'ee ilaaluuf murteesseera. Dhimmi kun itti fufee yoo argame komishiniin sun tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu akka danda'u ibseera.

title: Israeli forces detain three Palestinians as settlers seize tractor near Ramallah
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid in the West Bank village of Burqa, resulting in the arrest of three Palestinian residents. During the operation, Israeli settlers confiscated a tractor used for local trash collection while receiving support from the army. This incident highlights ongoing tensions in the region surrounding Ramallah.

english: In the remote region of Balochistan, the local economy relies heavily on the informal trade of Iranian fuel to support thousands of workers. Recent military conflicts involving Iran, the US, and Israel have disrupted this supply chain, causing significant financial hardship for laborers who depend on these deliveries. This instability highlights the economic vulnerability of residents who turn to smuggling as a survival strategy when formal employment opportunities are unavailable.

title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to a sixth province
english: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a sixth province, Bas-Uele, marking a concerning escalation in the disease's spread. With over 2,100 deaths reported, health officials warn that this strain is moving faster than any previous version and could become the deadliest on record. Efforts are currently underway to test new vaccines and experimental treatments to control the virus as the infection continues to move across the country.

english: China and Indonesia recently conducted joint naval exercises in waters located east of Taiwan. This activity has caused significant frustration in Taipei, as officials worry that Beijing is attempting to increase its military reach near the island. Taiwan fears these maneuvers are a calculated move to assert dominance over critical maritime trade routes.

english: US lawmakers are demanding an investigation into the USS Abraham Lincoln after reports surfaced of sailors attempting to jump overboard due to harsh conditions. amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ ለሁለተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን በሉሳካ ድምፃቸውን ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ምርጫ መንግስታቸው ባከናወናቸው የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች እና እየጨመረ በመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት ዙሪያ የህዝብን አቋም የሚለካበት ነው። መራጮች የፕሬዝዳንቱ የኢኮኖሚ ለውጥ ጥረቶች በቂ ናቸው ወይስ አይደሉም የሚለውን በድምፃቸው ይወስናሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Zaambiyaa Hakaayindee Hiichiileemaa irra deebi'anii filamuuf magaalaa Luusaakaatti sagalee isaanii kennaniiru. Filannoon kun mootummaan isaanii jijjiirama dinagdee fiduuf tattaaffii godhe fi gatiin jireenyaa dabaluun isaa biyyattiirratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa kan mirkaneessu dha. Lammiileen Zaambiyaa hojiin pirezidaantichaa waggoota darban keessa hojjetan itti fufiinsa isaanii kan murteessu ta'a.

title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
english: An individual in Norway's Svalbard archipelago was ordered to pay a 50,000 kroner fine for intentionally startling a resting polar bear. The person blew a ship's foghorn while passing the animal, which is a violation of local laws meant to protect wildlife from unnecessary human interference. The offender has accepted the penalty, which serves as a reminder that disturbing protected species in the region is strictly prohibited.
amharic: በኖርዌይ የስቫልባርድ ደሴቶች አንድ ግለሰብ የተኛን የዋልታ ድብ በጭጋግ ማስጠንቀቂያ ድምፅ (foghorn) በመረበሹ የ50,000 ክሮነር ቅጣት ተጥሎበታል። ድርጊቱ የተፈፀመው በጀልባ ሲጓዙ የነበሩ ሰዎች ድቡን ሲያዩ ድምፅ በማሰማት ድቡ እንዲነቃና ቦታውን እንዲለቅ በማድረጋቸው ነው። አካባቢውን የሚገዛው ህግ ማንኛውንም የዱር እንስሳ ያለአግባብ መረበሽ ስለሚከለክል፣ ግለሰቡ ቅጣቱን ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል።
oromo: Naannoo Svalbard kan biyya Noorweeyitti nama tokko orma hirriibaa keessa jiru sagalee guddiftuu bidiruu (foghorn) fayyadamuun waan dammeesseef qarshii 50,000 kaffaluuf dirqameera. Namichi kun kan gocha kana raawwate bineensicha lafa boqotutti jiru sagaleen wal-dhibdee uumee akka innis iddoo sana gadhiisee deemutti waan ta'eef, kunis seera eegumsa bineensotaa diigudha. Namichi kun adabbicha fudhateera, kunis naannicha keessatti bineensota eegumsa addaa qaban dammeessuun dhoorkaa ta'uu kan yaadachiisuudha.

title: Will all-out war in Yemen reignite as the Houthis escalate attacks?
english: Concerns are rising that Yemen could return to full-scale war following a recent surge in deadly Houthi attacks against government sites, civilian areas, and commercial shipping. These escalations have shattered the relative calm established by the 2022 truce, prompting government leaders to vow a firm response. While the government remains open to a political resolution, the intensifying violence threatens to destabilize the region further.
amharic: በየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቅርቡ በወሰዷቸው አደገኛ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ሀገሪቱ ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ልትመለስ ትችላለች የሚል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ከ2022 ጀምሮ የቆየውን አንጻራዊ ሰላም በመጣስ በመንግስት ተቋማት፣ በሲቪል አካባቢዎች እና በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የየመን መንግስት ለጥቃቶቹ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ ቢገልጽም፣ በሰላማዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት የሚያስችሉ አማራጮችን አሁንም እንደሚፈልግ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Houthiin weerara isaa guddifachuu isaan, Yemen gara waraana guutuu ta'eetti deebi'uu dandeessi soda jedhu uumameera. Weerara kana kanaan dura bara 2022 nagaa bu'ee ture kan diige yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan mootummaa, iddoowwan nagaa fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Mootummaan Yemen tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophii ta'us, karaa nagaatiin furmaata argachuuf fedhii akka qabu ibseera.

title: Turkiye’s AK Party turns 25: A journey of change and renewal
english: Turkiye’s Justice and Development (AK) Party is celebrating its 25th anniversary, marking a quarter-century of political leadership under President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. The party attributes its long-term success and stability to its deep historical roots and its ability to effectively address the evolving needs of the public. By transforming societal expectations into concrete government policies, the movement has maintained widespread support while navigating various national and global challenges.
amharic: የቱርክ የፍትህ እና ልማት ፓርቲ (AK) የተመሰረተበትን 25ኛ ዓመት የምስረታ በዓል እያከበረ ነው። ፓርቲው በፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان አመራር ስር ላለፉት ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት የቆየ ሲሆን፣ ይህን ያህል ጊዜ በስልጣን ለመቆየት የቻለው ከህዝብ ጥያቄዎች ጋር በመጣጣም እና ተጨባጭ የፖሊሲ ለውጦችን በማምጣት ነው። ፓርቲው ስኬቱን የጠበቀው የህዝብን ፍላጎት ወደ ተግባራዊ መርሃ ግብሮች በመቀየር እና በሀገር አቀፍ እንዲሁም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተከሰቱ ችግሮችን በብቃት በመወጣት ነው።
oromo: Paartiin AK kan Turkii waggaa 25ffaa hundeeffama isaa kabajachaa jiru yoo ta'u, kunis waggaa 25ffaa hoogganummaa Pirezidaant Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan mul'isa. Paartichi milkaa'ina isaa fi tasgabbii inni waggoota dheeraaf qabate, hidda seenaa isaa fi fedhii hawaasaa irratti hundaa'ee hojjechuu isaan akka ibse himameera. Paartichi gaaffilee hawaasaa gara karooraa fi imaammataatti jijjiiruudhaan, rakkoolee biyya keessaa fi idil-addunyaa injifachaa deggarsa bal'aa argachuu danda'eera.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz under its control, rejects Trump claims
english: Iranian military officials have asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is entirely under their control and management, directly contradicting recent claims of U.S. dominance made by President Donald Trump. Tehran insists that no ships can pass through this vital waterway without its permission and has tied the future reopening of the strait to U.S. compliance with existing peace deal obligations. This development highlights the ongoing tensions as Iran continues to restrict maritime traffic amid its broader conflict with the United States.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ሙሉ በሙሉ በእነሱ ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሚገኝ በመግለጽ፣ የዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ቀደም ብለው የሰጡትን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ቴህራን ያለምንም ፈቃዳቸው ማንም መርከብ በዚህ ወሳኝ የውሃ መስመር ማለፍ እንደማይችል በመግለጽ፣ የባህረ ሰላጤው መከፈት በአሜሪካ የሰላም ስምምነት ግዴታዎች ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የባህር ላይ ውጥረት አባብሶ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan akka jedhanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz guutummaatti to'annoo isaanii jala akka jiru ibsaniiru; kunis ibsa kanaan dura pirezidaant Doonald Tiraamp daandicharratti to'annoo guutuu qabna jechuun kennan kan mormudha. Teheran akka himtetti, hayyama isii malee markaan tokkollee daandii kana keessa darbuu akka hin dandeenyeefi, daandichii akka banamuuf immoo Ameerikaan dirqama walii galtee nagaa kabajuu akka qabdu ibsiteetti. Haalli kun walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti daandii galaanicharratti jiru kan dabaludha.

title: Pro-Palestine football fans lament West Ham for signing Manor Solomon
english: West Ham United has faced significant backlash from fans after signing Israeli winger Manor Solomon from Tottenham Hotspur. Supporters are protesting the move due to the player's vocal public support for Israel's military actions and policies throughout the ongoing conflict in Gaza. While the club views the signing as a strategic move to help secure promotion, the decision has triggered online criticism and calls for boycotts similar to those experienced at his previous clubs.
amharic: ዌስት هام ዩናይትድ የእስራኤላዊውን የክንፍ ተጫዋች ማኖር ሶሎሞንን ከቶተንሃም ሆትስፐር መቅጠሩ በደጋፊዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። ተጫዋቹ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች በይፋ በመደገፉ ምክንያት ደጋፊዎቹ ውሳኔውን በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው። ክለቡ ተጫዋቹን የፈረመው ወደ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ለመመለስ ቢሆንም፣ ውሳኔው ቀደም ሲል በሌሎች ክለቦች እንደታየው ሁሉ አሁንም በኢንተርኔት ላይ ትችት እና የቦይኮት ጥሪዎችን እየሳበ ይገኛል።
oromo: West Ham United taphataa garra galii Israa'el Manor Solomon gatuu isaa hordofee, mormiin cimaan garee deggartoota biraa irraa itti dhufeera. Deggartoonni kunneen, taphatichi waraana Gaaza keessatti adeemsifamu ilaalchisee Israa'eliif deggarsa ifa ta'e waan kenneef murtee kana mormuudha. Gareen kun taphaticha kan qaxarate gara Liigii Priimiyeritti deebi'uuf akka isa gargaaruuf ta'us, murteen kun akkuma klaboota kanaan duraa, miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti qeeqa fi yaada boycotii walitti fufaa jira.

title: Oman says massive oil spill reaches coastline: What damage could it do?
english: A significant oil spill from the tanker Caroline Bezengi has reached the coastline of Oman after leaking for several weeks. The spill, originating from a vessel that ran aground following an explosion, now covers over 2,000 square kilometers and threatens sensitive marine ecosystems near Ras Madraka and Masirah Island. Omani authorities are currently working to manage the environmental damage caused by the thousands of barrels of oil now impacting these coastal regions.
amharic: ካሮላይን ቤዘንጊ የተባለ የነዳጅ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ በመጋጨቱ ሳቢያ ለበርካታ ሳምንታት የፈሰሰው ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ነዳጅ ወደ ኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ ደርሷል። ፍንዳታ ደርሶበት ከተጋጨ በኋላ መፍሰስ የጀመረው ይህ ነዳጅ አሁን ከ2,000 ካሬ ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ቦታን የተቆጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ በራስ ማድራካ እና በማሲራህ ደሴት አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ስሱ የባህር አካባቢዎችን ስጋት ላይ ጥሏል። የኦማን ባለስልጣናት በባህር ዳርቻው ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የአካባቢ ብክለት ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Markabii boba'aa 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kan gubbaatti dhohee caccabe irraa kan buruqu jiru boba'aan hedduun, torbanoota hedduu booda qarqara galaana Omaan ga'eera. Boba'aan kun lafa iskuweer kiilomeetira 2,000 ol ta'u kan haguuge yoo ta'u, naannoo Ras Madraka fi Masirah Islanditti lubbu qabeeyyii galaanaatti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a. Abbootiin taayitaa Omaan miidhaa naannoo qarqara galaanaatti gahaa jiru kana hir'isuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Ukraine attacks key Russian grain terminal on Black Sea port
english: Ukraine recently launched a strike against a major Russian grain terminal located at the port of Novorossiysk. In response, Russia carried out retaliatory attacks on grain facilities within Ukraine’s Odesa region. These reciprocal strikes on vital food export infrastructure raise serious concerns regarding global food security for vulnerable nations.
amharic: ዩክሬን በኖቮሮሲይስክ ወደብ በሚገኘው የሩሲያ ዋና የእህል መጋዘን ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። በምላሹም ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ኦዴሳ ክልል በሚገኙ የእህል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። ሁለቱ አገራት እርስ በርስ በሚያደርጉት በዚህ የጥቃት ልውውጥ ሳቢያ በምግብ እጥረት ለተጎዱ አገራት ዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ ዋስትና ስጋት ላይ ወድቋል።
oromo: Yukireen buufata doonii Novorossiysk kan Raashiyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwatteerti. Kana boodas Raashiyaan bakka qubannaa midhaan sanyii kan naannoo Odesaa Yukireen keessatti haleelteerti. Wal-jijjiirraa haleellaa kana lamaan gidduutti godhamaa jiru kun biyyoota midhaan alaa galchaniif rakkoo nageenya nyaataa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Ebola outbreak caused by new ‘animal transmission’: What that means
english: A recent study reveals that the current deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo originated from a fresh animal-to-human transmission rather than previous virus strains. This specific Bundibugyo variant is spreading at an alarming rate, with over 2,000 fatalities recorded so far. Experts clarify that while the spillover is new, it does not represent a mutation or a change in how animals transmit the disease.
amharic: አዲስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ ያለው ገዳይ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ የቀድሞዎቹን የቫይረስ ዝርያዎች ሳይሆን ከአንስሳት ወደ ሰው በመተላለፉ የተከሰተ ነው። ቡንዲቡጊዮ የተሰኘው ይህ የቫይረስ ዝርያ በፍጥነት በመዛመት ከ2,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚያብራሩት ይህ ክስተት አዲስ ቢሆንም ቫይረሱ አልተቀየረም እንዲሁም እንስሳት ቫይረሱን የሚያስተላልፉበት መንገድ አልተለወጠም።
oromo: qorannoon haaraan akka agarsiisutti, dhibeen Ebolaa biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'achaa jiru kun dhukkuba kanaan dura ture osoo hin taane, bineensa irraa gara namaatti darbuun kan jalqabe dha. Vaayrasii 'Bundibugyo' jedhamu kanaan namoonni 2,000 ol du'aniiru. Ogeeyyoonni akka ibsanitti, vaayrasichi jijjiiramni irra hin geenye akkasumas bineensi dhukkubicha kan ittiin dabarsu dandeettii isaa keessatti jijjiiramni hin jiru.

title: Report from scene of Palestinian homes besieged by settlers
english: Israeli settlers have surrounded Palestinian homes in the West Bank village of Qusra, trapping families inside. During the siege, the residents have been deprived of essential utilities, including water and electricity. This incident highlights the ongoing danger and severe restrictions faced by Palestinians living in the occupied territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን ከበው ይገኛሉ። በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ላይ በተደረገው ይህ ከበባ፣ ቤተሰቦቹ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት እንዳያገኙ ተደርጓል። ይህ ድርጊት በተያዘው የፍልስጤም ግዛት ውስጥ ነዋሪዎች የሚገጥሟቸውን ከባድ ችግሮች እና ስጋቶች ያሳያል።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el qe'ee fi manaa jiraattoota Falasxiin kan Qusra, naannoo Baanki Dhihaa keessa jiran marsanii jiru. Miidhaa kana keessatti maatiin kunneen bishaan fi ibsaan akka itti hin geenye godhamanii jiru. Gochi kun rakkoo fi dhiibbaa cimaa jiraattoonni Falasxiin naannoo sanatti qabsoo irratti argaman agarsiisa.

title: Lebanese Americans sue US over Israel’s rights abuses in Lebanon war
english: A group of Lebanese Americans has filed a lawsuit against the US government and several major defense contractors for allegedly violating the Leahy Law. The plaintiffs, who include individuals with damaged property in Lebanon, argue that US military aid and weapon sales to Israel facilitate human rights abuses in the ongoing conflict. They are seeking legal action to hold these entities accountable, claiming that American laws restricting support to countries involved in rights violations are being ignored regarding Israel.
amharic: የሊባኖስ አሜሪካውያን ቡድን በአሜሪካ መንግስት እና በበርካታ የጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያዎች ላይ ክስ መስርተዋል። ተከሳሾቹ እስራኤል በሊባኖስ እያደረሰች ባለው ጥቃት የአሜሪካን ህግ በመጣስ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እና መሳሪያ በማቅረብ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት እንዲባባስ አድርገዋል ሲሉ ከሳሾቹ ይከራከራሉ። በሊባኖስ ንብረት የሆኑባቸው አሜሪካውያን፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት በሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ለሚሳተፉ ሀገራት ድጋፍ እንዳያደርግ የሚከለክለውን ህግ እያስከበረ አይደለም በማለት ለፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Humni lammiilee Ameerikaa kanneen sabboonummaa Liibanoota qaban tokko, mootummaa Ameerikaa fi dhaabbilee meeshaa waraanaa gurguran irratti himata bananiiru. Himataan kunneen, Ameerikaan gargaarsa waraanaa fi meeshaa waraanaa gara Israa'elitti erguun seera biyyattii kan 'Leahy Law' jedhamu kan cabsitee fi mirga namoomaa darbuu ishee akka gargaarte dubbatu. Namoonni qabeenyi isaanii Liibaanoos keessatti miidhame, Ameerikaan Israa'eliin gargaaruu ishee akka dhaabduu fi seera darbaa jirtuuf gaafatamummaa akka fudhatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Spanish Super Cup will be held in Turkiye in 2027
english: The 2027 Spanish Super Cup is scheduled to take place at the Ataturk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul, Turkey. The tournament will run from February 2 to 7 and include top clubs Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atletico Madrid, and Real Sociedad. This move comes as a temporary change because the Asian Cup schedule conflicts with hosting the event in Saudi Arabia, which is expected to host the tournament again in 2028.
amharic: የ2027 የስፔን ሱፐር ካፕ ውድድር በቱርክ፣ ኢስታንቡል በሚገኘው አታቱርክ ኦሊምፒክ ስታዲየም እንደሚካሄድ ተገልጿል። ውድድሩ ከየካቲት 2 እስከ 7 የሚቆይ ሲሆን ባርሴሎና፣ ሪያል ማድሪድ፣ አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ እና ሪያል ሶሴዳድ ይሳተፉበታል። ይህ ለውጥ የተደረገው በሳውዲ አረቢያ ሊካሄድ የነበረው ውድድር ከእስያ ዋንጫ ጋር በመደራረቡ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ውድድሩ በ2028 ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እንደሚመለስ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Qophiin 'Spanish Super Cup' bara 2027 magaalaa Istanbul, Turkey kan argamu 'Ataturk Olympic Stadium' irratti akka gaggeeffamu ibsameera. Taphoonni kunneen guraandhala 2 hanga 7 kan turan yoo ta'u, kilaboota gurguddoo kanneen akka Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atletico Madrid fi Real Sociedad kan hirmaachisan ta'a. Jijjiiramni kun kan mudate qophiin kun Saudii Arabiyaatti akka hin gaggeeffamneef walitti bu'iinsa 'Asian Cup' waliin walqabatee yoo ta'u, bara 2028 irra deebi'ee Saudii Arabiyaatti akka deebi'u eegama.

title: Turkiye lays out ‘mechanisms’ of defence pact with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new military alliance that treats an attack on one member as an assault on all three. This pact focuses on institutionalizing cooperation between their top defense and foreign officials through regular high-level meetings. The partnership also aims to advance military capabilities by conducting joint exercises and collaborating on the development of new technologies like drones and artificial intelligence.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ የሚቆጠርበት አዲስ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የሦስቱን አገራት ከፍተኛ የመከላከያ እና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በማቀናጀት የጋራ ግንኙነታቸውን በተቋማዊ መንገድ ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። በተጨማሪም አገራቱ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶች፣ በቴክኖሎጂ ልማት እና በድሮን እንዲሁም በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፎች በጋራ ለመስራት ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa’udii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan walii-galtee waadaa waraanaa haaraa kanneen keessaa tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame sadanuu irratti akka raawwatameetti fudhatamu mallatteessaniiru. Walii-galteen kun jiddu-galeessa ministiroota ittisaa fi dhimmi alaa biyyoota sadanii walitti fiduun hariiroo isaanii caalaatti cimsuuf kan karoorfatedha. Dabalataanis, biyyoonni kunneen leenjii waraanaa waloo gaggeessuu, akkasumas teeknoolojii haaraa fi meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa kanneen akka xiyyaara nama hin feene (drones) fi 'artificial intelligence' waliin misoomsuuf waliigalaaniiru.

title: Falling Danube flow forces shutdown of Romania’s sole nuclear plant
english: Romania has suspended operations at its only nuclear power plant because record-low water levels in the Danube River are insufficient to cool the facility's reactors. This plant typically provides one-fifth of the nation's electricity, forcing the government to rely on alternative energy sources and request public conservation. The shutdown is part of a broader crisis affecting the Danube as severe drought conditions continue to impact both energy production and river transport across Europe.
amharic: በሮማኒያ የሚገኘው ብቸኛው የኒውክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫ ጣቢያ በዳኑብ ወንዝ ላይ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የውሃ መጠን መቀነስ ምክንያት ስራውን አቁሟል። የኃይል ማመንጫው ለሀገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ ፍላጎት 20 በመቶውን ድርሻ የያዘ በመሆኑ፣ መንግስት የኃይል እጥረት እንዳይፈጠር አማራጭ የኃይል ምንጮችን በመጠቀም ለህዝቡ የኃይል ቁጠባ እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል። በአውሮፓ የገጠመው የድርቅ አደጋ የወንዙን የውሃ መጠን ወደ ታሪካዊ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ በማውረዱ የኤሌክትሪክ ምርትንም ሆነ የወንዝ ትራንስፖርትን በእጅጉ ጎድቷል።
oromo: Roomaaniyaa keessatti buufanni anniisaa niwuukileraa tokkichi biyyattii laga Daayinuubii keessatti sadarkaa bishaan hir'achuu isaatiin wal-qabatee hojii dhaabeera. Buufanni kun anniisaa elektirikaa biyyattii keessaa harka shan keessaa tokko kan maddisiisu waan ta'eef, mootummaan maddawwan anniisaa biroo fayyadamuuf fi hawaasni qusannoo akka godhu gaafateera. Hanqinni bishaan laga kanaa sababa gogiinsa cimaa Awurooppaa keessatti muudateen kan dhufe yoo ta'u, kunis oomisha anniisaa fi geejjiba lagichaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessiseera.

title: Infantino’s FIFA fate must go to an election, says Africa football chief
english: The head of African football, Patrice Motsepe, is insisting that FIFA President Gianni Infantino remain in his role until the scheduled elections next March. While major global football organizations are calling for Infantino to resign following controversies over his proposals to sell World Cup stakes, Motsepe maintains that the democratic voting process is the only appropriate way to determine his future. He argues that the 211 member nations should decide whether they still have confidence in Infantino’s leadership through a formal ballot.
amharic: የአፍሪካ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ፓትሪስ ሞትሴፔ፣ የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ እስከ መጪው መጋቢት ወር ድረስ በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ እና ውሳኔውም በምርጫ እንዲወሰን ጠይቀዋል። በርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ባቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ግፊት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ሞትሴፔ ግን ህጋዊው የፊፋ የምርጫ ሂደት ብቻ መከተል እንዳለበት ያምናሉ። የፊፋ 211 አባል ሀገራት በድምጽ ብልጫ መሪውን መደገፍ ወይም መቃወም እንዳለባቸውም አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin kubbaa miillaa Afrikaa Paatriis Mootseepee, pirezedantiin FIFA Jaannii Infaantiinoo hanga filannoo ji'a Bitootessaa dhufuutti bakka isaanii akka turanii fi garaagarummaan jiru karaa sanduuqa filannootiin akka hiikamu gaafataniiru. Jaarmoolen kubbaa miillaa gurguddoon addunyaa, Infaantiinoo karoora isaan qabeenya waancaa addunyaa gurguruuf qaban kana irratti mormuun akka gadi lakkisan gaafachaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, Mootseepee murteen waa'ee isaanii karaa dimokiraatawaa ta'een miseensota 211 tiin akka murtaa'uufi, isaanis filannoo irratti amanannaa akka qaban ykn hin qabne akka ibsan dubbataniiru.

title: Video: How settler attacks and water diversion erased a Palestinian community
english: A Palestinian Bedouin community near Jericho has been forced to abandon their homes due to persistent settler violence and the loss of essential water resources. Once a thriving oasis, the Ein al-Auja spring has been reduced to a trickle after its water was diverted, leaving the land dry. More than 100 families have been displaced as living conditions became impossible, forcing them to relocate to distant areas.
amharic: በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች በተደጋጋሚ በሚፈጸምባቸው የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እና የውኃ አቅርቦት መዛባት ምክንያት ቀያቸውን ለቀው ለመውጣት ተገደዋል። በአንድ ወቅት በውኃ ምንጮች ትታወቅ የነበረችው የአይን አል-አውጃ አካባቢ ውኃ በመዛበቷ ለኑሮ አስቸጋሪ ሆናለች። ከ100 በላይ የሚሆኑ ቤተሰቦች የመኖሪያ ቦታቸውን ጥለው ወደ ተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ለመሰደድ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Maatiin biyya Palestina kan Yerikoo bira jiraatan, haleellaa qaqqabuufi dhabamuun bishaan irraa kan ka'e qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisuuf dirqamaniiru. Bakki Ein al-Auja jedhamu kun yeroo darbe bishaan baay'ee qabaatee kan beekamu ture, garuu ammaan tana bishaanichi garabiraa waan deebifameef lafti sun goginaaf saaxilameera. Maatii 100 ol ta'an haalli jireenyaa waan itti ulfaateef qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii gara bakka biraatti godaananiiru.

title: Iranian press review: Tehran says it will no longer wait to be attacked
english: Iran has announced a significant shift in its military policy, moving away from a defensive stance to a more aggressive approach against U.S. forces in the region. This change follows the appointment of new military commanders by Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to replace those lost in recent conflicts. Officials have confirmed this strategy, citing recent operations against regional opposition groups as evidence of their new, proactive stance.
amharic: ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ያላትን አቋም ከመከላከል ወደ ጥቃት መሸጋገሯን ይፋ አድርጋለች። ይህ ለውጥ የመጣው ከፍተኛው መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ በቅርብ ግጭቶች ለተገደሉ ወታደራዊ አዛዦች ምትክ አዳዲስ ሰዎችን ከሾሙ በኋላ ነው። የሀገሪቱ የጦር መሪዎች ይህንን አዲስ ስትራቴጂ በማረጋገጥ፣ በቅርቡ በአካባቢው የተወሰዱ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የዚህ ፖሊሲ አካል መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Iraan naannoo giddu galeessa bahaatti humnoota Ameerikaarratti harka qabaachuurraa gara weeraraatti cehuuf, imaammata waraana ishee jijjiiruu beeksisiteetti. Jijjiirraan kun kan dhufu, hogganaan ol’aanaan biyyattii Mojtaabaa Kaameeneen ajajoota waraana haaraa bakka warra du’anii bakka buusuun hordofee dha. Ajajoonni waraanaa biyyattii tarkaanfiiwwan naannichatti fudhataman imaammata haaraa kanaan kan burqan ta’uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: UK withholds information on Israeli firm accused of targeting Scottish first minister in elections
english: The British government has declined to release information regarding an Israeli cybersecurity firm, BlackCore, which has been accused by a French watchdog of interfering in Scottish elections. Officials stated that withholding these details is necessary for national security and to maintain positive foreign relations. While the Scottish government released some internal documents, the UK Cabinet Office insists that disclosing further specifics would jeopardize national interests.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በስኮትላንድ ምርጫ ላይ ጣልቃ ገብቷል ተብሎ በተከሰሰው የኢትዮጵያ ሳይበር ደህንነት ኩባንያ ‘ብላክ ኮር’ ላይ ያለውን መረጃ ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም። ባለስልጣናቱ መረጃውን መደበቅ ለብሔራዊ ደህንነት እና ከሌሎች ሀገራት ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለመጠበቅ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የስኮትላንድ መንግስት አንዳንድ ሰነዶችን ይፋ ቢያደርግም፣ የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ካቢኔ ቢሮ ግን ተጨማሪ ዝርዝሮችን ማውጣት ለሀገሪቱ ደህንነት አደገኛ መሆኑን አሳውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Britaaniyaa dhaabbata saayibarii Israa'eel 'BlackCore' jedhamu kan filannoo Iskootlandirratti dhiibbaa geessise jedhamee shakkamu irratti ragaa jiru hunda baasuu dideera. Mootummaan kun ragaan kun akka hin baane kan godhe nageenya biyyaa fi hariiroo alaa eeguuf akka ta'e ibseera. Mootummaan Iskootland ragaa tokko tokko kan ifa godhe ta'us, waajjirri kaabinee Britaaniyaa odeeffannoo dabalataa baasuun nageenya biyyaa miidhuu akka danda'u ibsuun ragaicha dhokseera.

title: Five charts that explain the high cost of living in the UK
english: The United Kingdom is facing a significant rise in the cost of living, with inflation remaining high due to increased energy prices. This economic pressure is largely driven by global instability, particularly the conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran, which has disrupted fuel supplies. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is currently touring the country to address these widespread public concerns regarding the affordability of housing, food, and energy.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የኑሮ ውድነት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እየጨመረ ሲሆን በተለይም የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ለዋጋ ግሽበት ዋነኛ ምክንያት ሆኗል። በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ተጽዕኖ በማሳደሩ የትራንስፖርት እና የምግብ ዋጋ እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የዜጎችን የኑሮ ጫና ለመረዳት እና መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ በሀገሪቱ የጉብኝት መርሃ ግብር ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Biyyi Ingiliz baasii jireenyaa olka'aa ta'e keessa jirti, kunis gatii boba'aa dabaleen guddina gatii meeshaalee (inflation) hammaachiseera. Walitti bu'iinsi gidduu Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan jiru dhiyeessii boba'aa adunyaa irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, gatiin geejjibaa fi nyaataa akka dabalu ta'eera. Muummichi Ministiraa Andi Barnhaam rakkoo kana furuuf jecha hawaasa biyyattii irraa komii fi yaada dhaggeeffachuuf daawwannaa jalqabaniiru.

title: US-Iran talks in deadlock – what’s the latest?
english: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated as a standoff continues in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a significant drop in global shipping traffic. Iran maintains that it will keep the waterway blocked until the US addresses its demands regarding sanctions and reparations, despite President Trump’s claims of American control. Meanwhile, both nations continue to engage in hostile military actions, including naval blockades and targeted strikes, while diplomatic efforts to reach a peace agreement remain at a standstill.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ የአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ ቀንሷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የአሜሪካን ሙሉ ቁጥጥር ቢገልጹም፣ ኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ያቀረበችው ማዕቀብ እና ካሳ እስኪፈታ ድረስ የባህር ዳርቻውን እንደዘጋች ትቀጥላለች። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ የሰላም ንግግሮችም በአሁኑ ወቅት ምንም አይነት መፍትሄ ሳይገኙ ተስተጓጉለዋል።
oromo: Waliigalteen dhabamuun walitti buiinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru karaan Hormuz akka cufamu gochuun, sochiin dooniiwwan idil-addunyaa akka gadi bu'u taasiseera. Prezidaant Traamp to'annoo Ameerikaa jala akka jiru dubbatanis, Iraan hanga gaaffiin ishee waa'ee sanadaa fi kaffaltii miidhaa deebii argatutti karaan kun akka cufamee turu ibsiteetti. Gama biraan, biyyoonni lameen kutaalee waraanaa fi daangaa daldalaa irratti wal irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu itti fufanii jiran yoo ta'u, mariin nagaa sadarkaa duraa irratti dhaabbatee jira.

title: Colombia earthquake response tests new far-right government
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake recently struck western Colombia, resulting in over 260 deaths and widespread destruction shortly after President Abelardo de la Espriella took office. The government is working to provide emergency aid and financial relief to affected residents while managing the challenges of a difficult political transition from the previous administration. Although rescue efforts are underway in major cities, some remote areas are still struggling with limited resources and basic service outages.
amharic: በቅርቡ በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተ 7.4 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከ260 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ እስፕሪዬላ ስልጣን ከያዙ በኋላ ባጋጠመው በዚህ አደጋ፣ መንግስት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እና ለተጎጂዎች አስቸኳይ እርዳታዎችን ለማድረስ ጥረት እያደረገ ይገኛል። ይሁን እንጂ ከአዲሱ አስተዳደር ጋር በተፈጠረው የፖለቲካ ሽግግር ችግር ምክንያት የአደጋ ጊዜ ምላሹ ፈታኝ ሆኗል፤ አንዳንድ ገጠራማ አካባቢዎችም አሁንም እርዳታ እየጠበቁ ነው።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti sochiin lafaa hamaan guddina 7.4 qabu mudachuu isaatiin namoonni 260 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Preezdaanti Abelardo de la Espriella aangootti erga dhufanii yeroo gabaabaa booda balaan kun mudachuu isaatiin, mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa fi deeggarsa maallaqaa hir’uuf qabsaa’aa jira. Haa ta’u malee, ce’umsi siyaasaa mijataa hin taane fi giddu galeessa mootummaa durii wajjin wal qabatee jiru hojii gargaarsaa sana ulfaata taasiseera; naannolee baadiyyaa tokko tokko keessatti gargaarsi fi tajaajilli bu’uuraa ammayyuu hin geenye.

title: More than 135 million people in Europe face temperatures over 35C
english: A severe heatwave is currently hitting Europe, with over 135 million people enduring temperatures exceeding 35C. Nations like the UK and France are struggling with record-breaking heat, leading to critical workplace safety concerns for healthcare staff and widespread drought conditions. As the continent warms faster than any other, governments are under increasing pressure to address the consequences of climate change.
amharic: አውሮፓ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እየገጠማት ሲሆን ከ135 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች ከ35 ዲግሪ ሴንቲግሬድ በላይ በሆነ ሙቀት እየተሰቃዩ ይገኛሉ። እንደ እንግሊዝ እና ፈረንሳይ ያሉ አገራት ከመቼውም ጊዜ በላይ በሆነ የሙቀት መጠን እየተፈተኑ ሲሆን ይህም በጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ የሥራ ደህንነት ስጋትና በውሃ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ ድርቅ አስከትሏል። አውሮፓ በዓለም ላይ በፈጣን ሁኔታ እየሞቀች በመሆኗ፣ መንግስታት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥን ለመቋቋም ፈጣን እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስዱ ጫና እየተደረገባቸው ነው።
oromo: Awurooppaan yeroo ammaa kana ho'a cimaa keessa jirti, namoonni miliyoona 135 ol ta'an ho'a digrii seentigrade 35 irraa ol ta'e keessatti dararamaa jiru. Biyyonni akka UK fi Faransaay ho'a seenaa keessatti mul'atee hin beekneen kan rakkatan yoo ta'u, kunis hojjettoota fayyaa irratti rakkoo nageenyaa fi rooba dhabuu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo bishaanii uumeera. Awurooppaan addunyaa irratti bakka saffisaan ho'aa jiru waan ta'eef, mootummoonni jijjiirama qilleensaa kanaan dhufuu danda'u to'achuuf dhiibbaa cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Israel trucks out Gaza’s rubble to ‘hide genocide’ and ‘redraw the map’
english: Human rights organizations report that the Israeli military is systematically removing millions of tons of rubble from the Gaza Strip. Critics argue that this large-scale operation is designed to destroy critical evidence of war crimes and reshape the region's landscape. By moving debris from destroyed homes and cemeteries to undisclosed locations, Israel is accused of attempting to conceal the extent of the humanitarian disaster.
amharic: የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች የእስራኤል ጦር በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ቶን የፈራረሱ ሕንፃዎች ፍርስራሽን ከጋዛ ሰርጥ እያጓጓዘ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መጠነ ሰፊ እንቅስቃሴ የጦር ወንጀል ማስረጃዎችን ለማጥፋት እና የአካባቢውን ገጽታ ለመቀየር የታቀደ እንደሆነ ይነገራል። ፍርስራሾችን ከወደሙ ቤቶችና መቃብሮች በመሰብሰብ ወደማይታወቁ ቦታዎች በማዛወር፣ እስራኤል የደረሰውን ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ ጥፋት መጠን ለመደበቅ እየሞከረች እንደሆነ ተከሷል።
